title: Editor Settings
intro: Here you can customize various editor settings according to your preferences, settings are automatically saved as they are updated.
intro_assistant: Connect your AI provider accounts, pick default models, and test connectivity. Keys are stored locally and never leave your machine.
settings_file_info: Your settings file is located at
settings_file_info_assistant: Your AI provider config and conversations are stored at
autoindent_help: Automatically indent text on new lines.
wordwrap_help: Automatically break lines to fit the width of the editor.
editor_text_width_help: Center the Monaco editor surface within its pane (40–100%).
preview_text_width_help: Center live Markdown content within the preview pane (40–100%). Exported content is unchanged.
minimap_width_help: Approximate displayed width of the minimap (20–300 px).
scrollbar_visibility_help: Controls editor and preview scrollbars. Auto hide conceals them 1 second after scrolling stops.
scrollsync_help: Enable scroll sync between the editor and the preview.
session_restore_help: Reopen your previous tabs, workspace folder, and cursor positions when MKEditor starts.
clear_session_help: Wipes the persisted session file. Currently open tabs stay open; the next launch starts fresh.
clear_session_confirm_text: This wipes the persisted session file. Currently open tabs stay open; the next launch will start fresh.
systemtheme_help: Let your system theme override your stored settings.
ui_font_help: CSS font-family fallback list used by the application interface.
paste_images_directory_help: Relative paths (e.g. './assets') resolve against the active markdown file's folder. Absolute paths must sit inside the open workspace.
editor_font_help: CSS font-family list used by the Monaco Markdown editor.
preview_text_font_help: CSS font-family list used for rendered Markdown prose.
preview_code_font_help: CSS font-family list used for rendered Markdown code.
ui_zoom_help: Scale the application interface. Desktop only.
editor_zoom_help: Scale Markdown source text in the editor.
preview_zoom_help: Scale the live preview without changing export size.
line_numbers_min_chars_help: Minimum characters reserved for line numbers. The gutter expands automatically when the document needs more digits.
